definitions.explanation: Products used to enhance or alter the appearance of the face or body, including makeup, skincare, and beauty products.

examples.japanese: {化粧品|けしょうひん}{売|う}り{場|ば}で{口紅|くちべに}を{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought lipstick at the cosmetics counter.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}の{化粧品|けしょうひん}は{海外|かいがい}でも{人気|にんき}がある。
examples.english: Japanese cosmetics are popular overseas too.

examples.japanese: {化粧品|けしょうひん}にアレルギーがある。

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {化粧品|けしょうひん}{会社|がいしゃ} (cosmetics company)
- {化粧品|けしょうひん}{売|う}り{場|ば} (cosmetics counter)
- {化粧品|けしょうひん}を{使|つか}う (to use cosmetics)
- {基礎|きそ}{化粧品|けしょうひん} (basic skincare products)

RELATED TERMS:
- {化粧|けしょう} (makeup)
- コスメ (cosmetics, casual abbreviation)
- スキンケア (skincare)
